E0940

`#Memo` cannot cache a lazy `Iter` value (D-MEMO1=A)

What

`#Memo` cannot cache a lazy `Iter` value (D-MEMO1=A)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0940

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0940: tests/ui/memo_lazy_iter_arg_e0940.stderr.

Error [E0119]: there's no type called `Iter`
  --> tests/ui/memo_lazy_iter_arg_e0940.jet:2:27
    |
  2 | #Memo fn lazy_arg(values: Iter<Int>) Int -[]> 1
    |                           ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: generic types must name a struct or enum you defined
 Fix: check the spelling, or define the type first
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0119

Error [E0119]: `Iter` isn't generic
  --> tests/ui/memo_lazy_iter_arg_e0940.jet:2:27
    |
  2 | #Memo fn lazy_arg(values: Iter<Int>) Int -[]> 1
    |                           ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: only types declared with type parameters accept `<…>`
 Fix: use `Iter` without type arguments
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0119

Error [E0940]: `#Memo` cannot cache lazy `Iter` values
  --> tests/ui/memo_lazy_iter_arg_e0940.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | #Memo fn lazy_arg(values: Iter<Int>) Int -[]> 1
    | ^^^^^
 Why: a lazy iterator carries live computation state instead of one completed result
 Fix: materialize the iterator before the memoized boundary
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0940
